annotations.title: Read a verify run: what passed, what to fix

description: Store key: call after running the verify command, with the runId of that latest run. Pass or fail per check, and whether the server saw the run's sandbox order paid; when green, the go-live list. The CLI's PASS/WAIT/FAIL lines are authoritative: checks that only WAITed (sandbox guest sign-in) are missing here, so a run with no FAIL in the CLI has nothing to fix. While the store is closed the payment checks FAIL; rerun while it is open. If every check FAILed with locator.waitFor: Timeout, no menu item appeared: the server stopped or the origin differs from storefront_connect's; fix it and rerun. The record changes only when verify runs again.

runId.description: The runId of the latest verify run, as storefront_connect returned and the CLI printed it.

storefrontKey.description: The site's publishable storefront key, the same one given to storefront_connect.
